## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `SetupGuide`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `hubspot-crm-obj-products-setup-guide`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **SetupGuide**.

## Step 2: Navigate to private apps

1. <!-- manual: Log in to your HubSpot account. -->
2. Select **Settings** icon (gear icon) in the top navigation bar.
3. <!-- manual: In the left sidebar, go to Integrations → Private Apps. -->

## Step 3: Create a private app

1. Select **Create a private app**.
2. <!-- manual: On the Basic Info tab, enter a name for your app (e.g., Ballerina Products Connector) and optionally add a description and logo. -->
3. Select **Scopes**.

## Step 4: Copy the access token

1. After creating the app, HubSpot displays your **Access Token** on the app detail page.
2. Select **Show token** and copy the value; this is the bearer token you will use to authenticate.
3. Select **Done**.
